subject: Nimbus AI — DPA, subprocessor list & SCC applicability
messages:
From: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@nimbus.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbus.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA + SCCs applicability for upcoming purchase order

Hi Jordan —

We are moving quickly toward contract execution for the proof-of-concept (POC). Our legal team asked me to send our standard DPA and confirm whether Redwood is willing to sign with EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and provide a current subprocessor list.

Attached: nimbus_standard_dpa_v1.pdf (redlines likely)

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm SCCs applicability (we’re EU-based customers for the POC)?
- Can you provide a current subprocessor list and SOC 2 evidence (or point to where we can download under NDA)?

We prefer DocuSign for execution — procurement@ will coordinate.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rivera
Head of Procurement, Nimbus AI
Elena.Rivera@nimbus.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@nimbus.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs applicability for upcoming purchase order

Hi Elena —

Thanks for sending over the DPA. Looping in Neha (legal ops) and Karthik (privacy) to confirm scope. Quick answers up front:
- We can accept SCCs for EU customers; we typically apply the EU SCC Annex Ia + controller-to-processor addendum in our execution flow.
- We maintain a realtime subprocessor registry; snapshot attached.
- SOC 2 report can be shared under a standard NDA — we usually provide a summary first.

Neha / Karthik — could you review the attached DPA and flag any high-risk redlines? I’ve attached our template as a reference.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_template_v1.pdf, subprocessor_list_snapshot_20270520.csv

Proposed next steps: small 30-min sync today or tomorrow to triage legal items and confirm DocuSign recipients. If procurement requires specific execution flow (countersigned by their signature tool), let us know.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs applicability for upcoming purchase order

Thanks for the tag, Jordan. I reviewed Nimbus' DPA quickly — high-level notes below. I'll prepare a tracked-redline DOCX but wanted to call out the gating items so the commercial team can set expectations with the customer.

Top concerns from legal:
- Audit & inspection clause: Nimbus is asking for "customer-controlled audits" and on-site audits. We are willing to provide SOC 2 Type II and cooperate with a third-party assessment but cannot grant unrestricted on-site audits. Recommend proposing a restricted audit clause: auditor of record + scoped review with at least 30 days’ notice and covered by NDA.
- Retention and deletion: Their retention schedule is aggressive (data delete within 15 days). Need to confirm which data categories apply (logs, backups, aggregated telemetry).
- Subprocessors: confirm timing for notice (we push 30-day notice and opt-out for specific subprocessors only in limited circumstances).
- SCCs: acceptable; will attach standard controller->processor language and confirm Annex implementation.

I attached a quick SOC2 summary we can send, and I'll upload a tracked redline (redline_nimbus_dpa_from-jb.docx) with proposed edits.

Attachments: soc2-summary-2027.pdf, redline_nimbus_dpa_from-jb.docx

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Legal Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@nimbus.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbus.ai, dpo@nimbus.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs applicability for upcoming purchase order

Jordan / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from our side after a round with our in-house counsel:
- The SOC 2 summary is fine as an interim; legal needs the SOC 2 report under NDA before countersignature.
- The audit clause is a redline for us; we typically require the ability to have a certified auditor perform a scoped examination. On-site is a fallback. Is the restricted-audit compromise acceptable?
- For subprocessors, legal wants a contractual commitment to provide at least 10 business days' notice of new subprocessors for this contract (they cited compliance with local regulators).
- Execution: procurement prefers to use their DocuSign tenant (they have required fields tied to their PO system). Are you able to accept a countersigned DocuSign from their tenant, or must we use Redwood's DocuSign envelope?

Attached: nimbus_standard_dpa_v1_marked.pdf (their redlines)

We can do a short call at 16:00 PT if that helps.

Regards,
Elena
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@nimbus.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs applicability for upcoming purchase order

Elena —

Appreciate the clarity. Quick summary and proposed path forward so we’re aligned:

1) SOC 2 report: OK to provide full report under NDA. Jordan will share an NDA link (or we can execute a mutual NDA) and then deliver the report. In the interim, SOC2 summary is acceptable for commercial sign-off.

2) Audit clause: Neha's suggested compromise (scoped third-party assessment with 30 days' notice) is our preferred position; we cannot commit to unrestricted on-site audits. Neha, please prepare the exact suggested language and I’ll share with Nimbus legal.

3) Subprocessors: Redwood will provide a snapshot of the subprocessor list at execution and agrees to notify Nimbus of any processors added during the contract term. We can commit to a 10-business-day notice for this customer for the POC as a commercial concession — confirm if that works.

4) Execution flow: We can accept Nimbus’ DocuSign tenant for countersignature as long as Redwood is listed as a required signer and the envelope includes the final agreed-upon DPA. Procurement: please share the intended signer email(s) and any required fields.

5) Next steps: Proposed 30-min sync tomorrow — https://doodle.com/sync/meet/30min/nimbus-dpa-sync or we can take offline via redlines. I’ll also upload the SOC2 NDA today and the snapshot of the subprocessor list.

If that plan looks good, Elena, confirm acceptance of the 10-business-day notification for subprocessors and we’ll proceed to redline reconciliation.

Thanks,
Jordan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
